events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) firms up in Podziemski's (GSW) path and absorbs the contact that occurs during the pick.
Looney (GSW) places his hand on Sengun's (HOU) back and does not apply force as Sengun releases away during his layup attempt.
Wiggins (GSW) and Brooks (HOU) tangle arms as they move around the screen and the contact quickly dissolves.
Payton II (GSW) dislodges Green (HOU) from his rebounding position.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Green (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. After review, it is determined that the ball was last touched by Wiggins (GSW). Possession is awarded to HOU.
Looney (GSW) is moves slightly forward toward Green's (HOU) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Sengun (HOU) grasps Payton II's (GSW) arm as he maintains a vertical position and the marginal contact does not prevent him from contesting.
VanVleet (HOU) swipes down and initiates contact with Kuminga's (GSW) arm, which affects his post shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) makes a move towards the basket and the contact with Wiggins' (GSW) side is marginal.
Both Brooks (HOU) and VanVleet (HOU) move/jump alongside Kuminga's (GSW) path and maintain a legal guarding position without initiating arm contact with him as they defend the driving shot attempt.
Payton II (GSW) closes out to the side and legally contests VanVleet's (HOU) jump shot attempt. The marginal foot to leg contact that occurs after the release is initiated by VanVleet.
Sengun (HOU) initiates the marginal contact with Looney (GSW) by briefly grasping his arm during the rebound.
Smith Jr. (HOU) commits a take foul on Wiggins (GSW).
Looney (GSW) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jump shot attempt.
